evals.prompt: Add a MultiFileField to the parametrization so users can upload multiple .rgp files, then in the DataView read those files and show the number of uploaded files as a DataItem.
evals.expected_output: Parametrization with a MultiFileField restricted to .rgp extension, Controller DataView method that guards against None, iterates over file resources, and returns a DataResult with a DataGroup containing a DataItem for the count.

evals.prompt: Organise the parametrization into two tabs: 'Invoer' and 'Opties'. Under 'Invoer' add a Section 'Geometrie' with a NumberField for diameter (mm) and a NumberField for length (mm). Under 'Opties' add a BooleanField to enable filtering.
evals.expected_output: Parametrization class with two Tab instances, the first containing a Section with two NumberFields with Dutch labels and mm suffix, the second containing a BooleanField. All labels in Dutch, code identifiers in English.

evals.prompt: Add a PlotlyView to the controller that plots the drill signal from a single uploaded .rgp file. The file is already parsed into an RPDMeasurement object that has a drill_amp attribute (list of floats). Show depth on the x-axis and amplitude on the y-axis.
evals.expected_output: Controller view method decorated with @vkt.PlotlyView, creates a plotly go.Figure with a go.Scatter trace using an index-based x-axis and drill_amp on y, returns PlotlyResult(fig). Imports plotly.graph_objects as go.
